newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks claw back early gains by day's end.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks claw back early gains by day's end.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended higher on Monday after clawing back late in the session to recoup early morning gains.
Brokers said market direction was vague and the rises were brought on by bargain-hunting and buy-backs of shares which had been sold off lately.
The Nikkei 225 closed 129.86 points or 0.72 percent higher at 18,053.50, but below the 18,084.05 high posted in the morning. Its June futures rose 230 points to 18,060.
"Shares such as Mitsubishi Heavy were bought back but on the other hand securities and banks were sold off again," said Kunihiro Hatae, Tokyo Securities general manager.
